title: After Accepting
description:
Two months since you decided to accept what Jiyeon said.
You thought it was the right call.
Today a short message from Jiyeon.
'Oppa — how've you been?'

choices.result_text:
'Hanging in there, more or less,' you said.
Jiyeon replied 'That means you're okay.'

'I'm good,' you said.
Jiyeon said 'Good to hear.'

title: After Turning Down Coffee
description:
A month since you declined Jiyeon's invitation for coffee.
Today you ran into her in the hallway.
She gave an awkward smile.

choices.text: "I'm sorry I said no back then."
choices.result_text:
'I didn't have the bandwidth then.'
Jiyeon said 'It's okay. I kind of sprung it on you.'

You nodded.
She nodded back.

title: What Choosing the Goal Meant
description:
Three months since you chose your goal over the relationship with Jiyeon.
Today you looked back at whether that was right.
Your assets had grown since then.

choices.result_text:
The number had grown.
That didn't justify the choice itself.

choices.text: I think I was too cold
choices.result_text:
There was a lingering regret.
Chasing a goal, but not treating people as costs.

title: When You Spoke Honestly About the World
description:
Two months since you told Jiyeon what you honestly thought about how the world works.
Today she reached out first.
'Oppa — what you said then. I keep thinking about it.'

choices.result_text:
Jiyeon pointed to a single line.
It had come out while you were just being honest — not rehearsed.

'Thanks for remembering,' you said.
Jiyeon smiled.

title: After Keeping Distance
description:
Two months since you decided to keep your distance from Daeun.
Today you spotted her from far away.
You passed without saying anything.

choices.result_text:
You passed.
Being close wasn't always the right thing with a good person.

choices.text: Maybe I could at least say hello
choices.result_text:
'Hello, Daeun-ssi,' you said.
She said 'Oh — Minjun-ssi. Long time.'

title: Knowing Daeun Is Fine
description:
A month since you confirmed Daeun was doing well.
Your mind felt a little lighter after.
Today you heard about her again.

choices.result_text:
Good for her.
Even when the connection was severed — knowing the other person was okay made the weight lift.

choices.text: The thought of reaching out crosses my mind
choices.result_text:
You wanted to reach out.
But you couldn't tell if it was for her or for yourself.

title: The Uncertainty
description:
That time when you couldn't be sure how you felt about Daeun.
The uncertainty still hasn't resolved.
Today Daeun walked past with a smile.

choices.result_text:
Not every feeling needed to be named.
Leaving a feeling uncertain — could be a form of respect for the other person.

You said hello.
Daeun responded warmly.

title: After Hearing Jaehyuk's Story
description:
Two months since you heard Jaehyuk's story.
Everyone has a reason — you were reminded of that then.
Today you ran into Jaehyuk.

choices.result_text:
Jaehyuk said '...It was nothing.'
No words — but his expression was different.

You said hello.
He said hello back.

title: After Pushing Jaehyuk
description:
A month since you pushed Jaehyuk to the wall.
Today word came that Jaehyuk had left the company.

choices.text: Wonder if pushing him made a difference
choices.result_text:
The causation wasn't clear.
But — it might have been the final push.

choices.text: It was probably the right move for him
choices.result_text: Whatever the reason — you hoped leaving was better for him.

title: After Sangchul's Invitation
description:
A month since Sangchul invited you to that gathering.
Some of the people you met there reached out today.

choices.result_text:
You met again.
Sangchul's network was his — and now, just a little, yours too.
An introduction makes a relationship. A relationship makes an opportunity.

"Can't make it this time," you said.
They understood.

title: Taking Sangchul's Warning
description:
Two months since you listened to Sangchul's warning and stayed out.
Today the outcome showed.
The people who went in took a loss.

choices.result_text:
'Your warning kept me out. Thanks,' you said.
Sangchul said 'Of course. That's what you do.'

You felt the relief quietly.
Listening to the warning had been right.

title: Ignoring Sangchul's Warning
description:
Two months since you dismissed Sangchul's warning.
Today the outcome landed.
Exactly as he'd said.

choices.result_text:
'You were right,' you said.
Sangchul said 'Listen next time.'

You didn't say anything.
But you remembered.

title: Sangchul's Tip Result
description:
Two months since you acted on Sangchul's tip.
Today the outcome is in.

choices.text: It was right — he has a good eye
choices.result_text:
It worked out.
You texted Sangchul briefly. Just: 'Done.'
He replied: 'Obviously.'

It was wrong.
Sangchul's tip wasn't a guarantee.
Good intentions and accurate information are different things.

title: After Forgiving the Complexity
description:
Two months since you understood Jiyeon's complicated situation and forgave her.
It wasn't easy.
Today Jiyeon reached out first.

choices.result_text:
You talked for a long time.
Forgiveness wasn't the end of a relationship — it was the start of the next stage.

choices.text: Keep it short, just check in
choices.result_text:
You exchanged a brief update.
Forgiveness doesn't always bring everything back.

title: After Acknowledging It
description:
A month since you admitted your mistake to Jiyeon.
Today you thought back to her reaction.
She hadn't said anything at the time.

choices.result_text:
Saying nothing was also a kind of answer.
The fact that Jiyeon went quiet — meant she heard it.

choices.text: She might not have accepted it yet
choices.result_text:
She was still processing, it seemed.
Even accepting an acknowledgment takes time.
